notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.9
notes.content:
This update introduces major systems to the homeworld, including new resources, buildings, inventory logic, player stat changes, UI polish, save/load functionality, and the foundation for research progression.
[hr][/hr]New: Inventory System
Implemented a full inventory system with clear separation between Resources and Items.

Resources (e.g. oil, power, research points) are kept on death.

Items (e.g. tools, consumables, blueprints) are lost on death, introducing a risk-reward element to exploration, expanding on the roguelike aspects.
[hr][/hr]Player Stat Change: Overheating
Replaced Stamina with a new Overheating system.

Performing tasks builds up heat over time.

Overheating reduces performance and requires cooldown periods.

Reflects the robotic nature of your character and adds tension during prolonged activity.
[hr][/hr]New Resource: Research Points
Research Points have been added as a new collectible and storable resource.

Used to unlock advanced technologies, upgrades, and blueprints.

Earned by defeating enemies, completing objectives, or processing rare materials.

Stored globally and persist through death and level transitions.
[hr][/hr]New Resource: Oil
Added as a key fuel resource for your base.

Extracted from the environment using Oil Extractors.

Used to fuel power generators and some crafting recipes.

Stored in Oil Tanks for efficient management and long-term use.
[hr][/hr]New Resource: Power
Power has been added as a core energy resource for your base.

Used to operate buildings, machinery, and automation systems.

Generated by oil-fuelled and solar generators.

Stored in Power Cores to provide backup and ensure steady supply.
[hr][/hr]Building System Enhancements
Building component system updated for better performance, modularity, and resource logic handling.

Prepared for future expansion with an easy-to-use modular framework to support quick feature additions and scalability.
[hr][/hr]New Buildings
Oil Extractor – Extracts raw oil from environmental patches.

Power Generator – Consumes oil to produce power.

Solar Generator – Produces free power during the daytime, with no fuel cost.

Oil Tank – Stores large amounts of refined oil.

Power Core – Stores generated power for later use.
[hr][/hr]UI Improvements
Expanded resource UI with updated icons, resource bars, and contextual tooltips.

Improved building placement feedback and alignment visuals.
[hr][/hr]Save / Load System
Full Save and Load system now active.

Autosave occurs:

On level transitions

During major player actions (e.g. placing buildings)

At 5-minute set intervals

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.8
notes.content:
This update marks a significant shift in gameplay perspective, transitioning from a top-down shooter to a third-person shooter, alongside key combat, map, and UI improvements.
[hr][/hr]Major Gameplay Change
Changed the core gameplay perspective from top-down shooter to third-person shooter.

Reworked camera, controls, and player movement to fit the new third-person style.
[hr][/hr]Map & Environment
Expanded and refined the testing map for the new gameplay perspective.

Added new environmental props to complement the third-person experience.
[hr][/hr]Combat Improvements
Balanced combat mechanics to suit third-person gameplay.

Added VFX for Hover Enemies for better visual clarity.
[hr][/hr]Performance & Fixes
Optimised AI by limiting active enemies based on player count.

Fixed collision issues with destroyed enemies.
[hr][/hr]UI Enhancements
Continued development of Main Menu and Pause Menu to improve navigation and usability.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.7
notes.content:
This update brings enhanced AI control, flexible world design, new combat mechanics, accessibility features, and controller support.
[hr][/hr]AI & World Design
Implemented advanced AI behaviour control with EQS (Environment Query System) usage.

Re-designed asset modularity to improve flexibility in world design and level creation.
[hr][/hr]Combat & Abilities
Added new weapon modes for varied combat options.

Improved Dash ability for smoother player movement.

Projectiles now support colour changes for better visual feedback.
[hr][/hr]Accessibility & Controls
Added an accessibility feature to assist with aiming direction.

Added full controller support for enhanced gameplay options.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.6
notes.content:
This update addresses multiple bug fixes, visual improvements, AI and UI enhancements to improve overall gameplay experience.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed health bar displaying integral units instead of smooth values.

Fixed melee and ranged damage values not saving correctly.

Fixed bug reporter hiding the mouse cursor after closing.

Fixed the ability to “spam click” melee attacks.

Fixed character rotation when off-camera.

Fixed AI navigation and rotation issues.

Fixed bug reporter functionality.
[hr][/hr]Visual & UI Improvements
General visual improvements across the game.

HUD and UX improvements for clearer player feedback.

Expanded and improved auto-aim functionality for better responsiveness.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.5
notes.content:
This update introduces new scoring mechanics, player abilities, UI improvements, and fixes to enhance gameplay and stability.
[hr][/hr]New Features
Added Game Score system to track player performance.

Introduced Score Multiplier to reward skillful play.

Added the ability for the player to jump.

Implemented revision control to better manage updates and changes.

Added player experience system for progression.

Enabled interaction with the Upgrade Station for player upgrades.
[hr][/hr]Visual & UI Improvements
Enhanced visuals on the Playtest Map.

Re-fixed sound attenuation for accurate audio behavior.

Various UI changes for improved user experience.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed issues with Save/Load functionality.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.4
notes.content:
Gameplay Enhancements & UI Fixes
This update adds new gameplay features, improves AI behaviour, enhances audio, and fixes UI inconsistencies for a smoother player experience.
[hr][/hr]New Features
Added assisted aiming to improve player targeting accuracy.

Introduced sound attenuation for more realistic audio distance effects.

Added a basic character sheet for player stats and overview.

Added a "Continue" button to the main menu to streamline game resumption.
[hr][/hr]Gameplay Improvements
Improved AI projectile collision detection for more reliable enemy behaviour.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed issue where Exit Game option incorrectly displayed as Exit to Menu.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.3
notes.content:
This update introduces a new bug reporting utility and improvements to AI, map testing, and audio settings to enhance gameplay and user experience.
[hr][/hr]New Features
Implemented a bug reporting utility integrated with Codecks to streamline issue tracking and player feedback.
[hr][/hr]Gameplay Improvements
Expanded the TopDownMap testing area to allow better player movement testing and navigation.

Updated Gunner AI logic to prevent enemies from spawning inside the floor.
[hr][/hr]UI / Settings
Fixed audio settings so the volume defaults correctly instead of appearing muted on first launch.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.2
notes.content:
This update focuses on improving user experience with placeholder UI options, gameplay tweaks, and important bug fixes to ensure smoother play.
[hr][/hr]UI Improvements
Added the ability to adjust audio volume in the settings menu.

Added a "Return Home" button in the pause menu to quickly return to the hubworld.
[hr][/hr]Gameplay Fixes & Improvements
Fixed the timer not updating properly during gameplay.

Removed collision from objective zones to prevent players from getting stuck or blocked.

Improved the enemy counter for more accurate and responsive feedback.

Adjusted blocker height to fix z-fighting visual glitches in level geometry.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.1
notes.content:
Welcome to the first public alpha of AstroMatTech! This initial release lays the foundation for core gameplay systems and sets the stage for future updates.
[hr][/hr]First Playable Build
This marks the first playable Alpha version of AstroMatTech.

Core systems are in place for early feedback and testing.

Many features are still in development; your input is highly valued!
[hr][/hr]Feedback Request
Please share your thoughts on balance, features, bugs, and overall experience.
[hr][/hr]Thank You
Thank you for trying out the alpha version!

We’re just getting started—more updates, features, and polish are on the way.

notes.title: Devlog: 01
notes.content:
Welcome to Astromattech!


Introducing the Studio!


Hello and welcome! We are Aevum Interactive, a small Indie studio based in Cheshire, United Kingdom. Our passion for games is what drives us to create the best possible experiences for our players. We are a small team however our aspirations are mighty.

Our goal is to create games that are not only entertaining but also meaningful, creating stories, evoking emotions and leaving a lasting impression on our players. Games have always held a meaningful place within our lives, we want to create that very same feeling for others.

Our Plan!


We believe that the best games are created by not only the minds of the developers, but the minds of those that play. We are committed to engaging with our players at every stage of development, we want to hear your thoughts and ideas, we want you to have your say to make a game you love.

Our goal is to create a collaborative environment where players and developers can work together to create something truly special. We want our players to feel like they are a part of the process, and we want them to be proud of the games that we create together.

To achieve this, we will be hosting regular playtests and surveys to gather feedback from our players. We will also be active on our Discord community and various social media platforms, so that we can engage with our community and hear your thoughts and opinions.

We want to thank our community in advance for their support, and we can't wait to see what we can create together!

We are excited to embark on this journey and can't wait to share our games with you. Stay tuned for updates and announcements as we continue to grow and develop as a studio.

Thank you for joining us on this adventure!

Join us on Discord!
